knowledge.title: Intake playbook — new anesthesia requisition
knowledge.bodyMarkdown:
# Intake playbook

When a new requisition lands:

1. Confirm start date and length-of-assignment with the facility contact.
2. Validate the state license requirement and whether the facility accepts IMLC.
3. Open at least two providers from the top-10 call-list within 24 hours.

**Red flags:** CRNA-independent states vs. MD-supervised, weekend-only shifts, housing stipend ambiguity.

knowledge.title: Rate-band policy — 2026 Q1
knowledge.bodyMarkdown: Current floor: $180/hr for general anesthesia, $200/hr for cardiac. Hold the floor unless the facility pre-negotiates with the agency lead.
